name: Apple M4 Pro (MacBook Pro 14-inch, 2024)
memory_bandwidth_basis: Apple tech specs: '273GB/s memory bandwidth' for the M4 Pro with 12-core CPU / 16-core GPU; configurable to M4 Pro with 14-core CPU / 20-core GPU at the same 273GB/s. Unified-memory bandwidth, package-level, shared with the CPU.
notes: M4 Pro: 16-core or 20-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, up to 48GB unified memory. The 273GB/s bandwidth is the base configuration; the M4 Max at 410GB/s or 546GB/s is the higher-bandwidth option. For local LLM inference, the 48GB unified pool can hold a 70B model at 4-bit (~35GB weights) with room for KV cache, but the 273GB/s bandwidth limits decode speed to roughly 8-12 tokens/sec for a 70B model. The M4 Pro is the entry point for serious local LLM work on Apple Silicon.
